General Intelligence & Reasoning.description: Verbal and non-verbal reasoning: series, coding-decoding, direction sense, blood relations, analogy, syllogism, classification, ranking, alphabet/number puzzles. NOTE: figure-based questions (mirror image, paper-folding, cubes/dice, non-verbal series) must be described precisely in words since this platform is text-only — no diagrams.
topics: Non-verbal reasoning described in words (e.g. simple described figure series, dice/cube logic without needing an image)
